description: Election Commission - Veerasingan Vijajenthiran was elected as the memeber of the Ward-07 Chavakachcheri Town 02 Chavakachcheri Urben Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Chavakachcheri Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a newly elected member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election-related declarations for local authorities.
